query: Here is the prompt we have been using for our hero images and it is not working well: 'a professional photorealistic image of a happy diverse team in a modern office, high quality, 8k, trending on artstation, best lighting, ultra realistic'. The results look generic and plastic. Fix this for a B2B fintech landing page hero.
expected_behavior: Identifies why the prompt fails: vague words like 'photorealistic', 'high quality', '8k', and 'trending on artstation' do not specify an actual capture setup
Restructures the prompt into separate Subject, Style, Light, and Camera fields instead of one run-on sentence
Replaces 'photorealistic' and 'ultra realistic' with a concrete lens, aperture, and light direction
Specifies an aspect ratio matching the hero placement and a safe zone for overlay copy
Documents the revised prompt so it reproduces, not just a one-off fix

checks.value: (?i)(this prompt looks fine|no changes needed|ready to use as[- ]is|good to go)
